scientific_integrity: Proof of completeness is a finite enumeration algorithm combined with published cycle equivalence on trees; executable checker is supplied; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification restricted to simple trees of at most ten vertices with identical fixed up/down thresholds (1,3) and permutation-sequential rounds; no general asymptotic. Novelty is bounded by available primary full texts and indexed records.
title: Sharp ten-vertex period cutoff for sequential bi-threshold dynamics on trees
